items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...George is still up in Chicago George burns the trombone play and he's still playing well Johnny played with him recently played with me three days ago in manassas virginia

ctx.x: This is WTIX 690, New Orleans, Louisiana. Here's Joe Collada.

Thank you very much, sir. Today's subject, jazz, Dixieland, whatever you want to call it, by one of the greats, Mr. Johnny Wiggins, Wiggs, I beg your pardon, sir, and by one of the true authorities in the country from Tulane University, Mr. Dick Allen. High Karate After Shave and Cologne presents Electric Train! Back in tune with more of Let's Talk It Over, we're going to get back in just a moment to Snoozer Quinn on My Melancholy Baby, and we'll have some comments on that by Mr. Johnny Wiggs of Johnny Wiggs and…
Yeah, I couldn't think of his last name, but I have thought of it. Tell him, Dick. Papa John Joseph.
